solution:
Each ring adds one unit to both ends of each side length. Starting from the center square of side 1, the square through ring 100 therefore has side 1 + 2 × 100 = 201. The square through ring 99 has side 1 + 2 × 99 = 199.
Subtract their areas to count only the unit squares in ring 100: 201² − 199² = (201 − 199)(201 + 199) = 2 × 400 = 800.
Final answer: 800
